cohort: 559 primiparous women with a singleton, cephalic presentation fetus in the absence of fetal growth restriction, oligohydramnios, pre-eclampsia, pre-existing diabetes mellitus or an indication for planned Cesarean delivery
finding: The Genesis Cesarean delivery prediction tool, based on maternal height, BMI, fetal head circumference, and fetal abdominal circumference, demonstrated good predictive capacity for emergency Cesarean delivery in a validation study.
